title: Separable algebraic tensor finite purely inseparable is a field
statement: Let $k$ be a field, let $k'/k$ be a separable algebraic field extension [def-weil-pbc-separable-algebraic-extension] and let $L/k$ be a finite purely inseparable field extension [def-weil-pbc-finite-purely-inseparable-extension]. Then the ring $L'=k'\otimes_kL$ is a field, and via the ring map $k'\to L'$, $c\mapsto c\otimes1$, $L'$ is a finite purely inseparable field extension of $k'$ with $\dim_{k'}L'=\dim_kL$.

source.place: Lemma Tag 07QH (lemma-geometrically-regular-over-separable-algebraic, line 47219), proof, first paragraph: 'Then $L' = k' \otimes_k L$ is a field (see material in Fields, Section 037H)'. Section 037H (fields-section-algebraic, fields.tex line 3692) is only a review of definitions and does not state this; the same claim is used in the proofs of Algebra Lemmas 0384 (geometrically normal, line 47062) without further reference. No exact Stacks tag found for the claim.

proof.text: Use Mathlib IntermediateField.LinearDisjoint.isField_of_forall: in each common field Ω, transfer separability to the image of k' and pure inseparability to the image of L using AlgEquiv.ofInjective. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-separable-purely-inseparable-linear-disjoint] to these two intermediate fields. The forall criterion then gives IsField of the abstract tensor product, without constructing a compositum explicitly.

source.place: Algebra, Lemma Tag 07QH (lemma-geometrically-regular-over-separable-algebraic), proof, first paragraph; the cited field-theory material is Fields Tags 030K and 037H.

proof.text: Equip the tensor product with the field structure determined by its proved IsField property. Choose an exponential characteristic q of k; injectivity of k → k' gives the same exponential characteristic on k'. For each tensor x, Mathlib IsPurelyInseparable.exists_pow_pow_mem_range_tensorProduct_of_expChar gives an n with x^(q^n) in the image of k'. Mathlib isPurelyInseparable_iff_pow_mem yields pure inseparability. This includes characteristic zero, where q = 1. The finite purely inseparable hypothesis is [def-weil-pbc-finite-purely-inseparable-extension].

source.place: Algebra, Lemma Tag 07QH proof, first paragraph ('Then L' = k' tensor_k L is a field'); the exponent and Frobenius calculation fills in the field-theory step referred to Fields Section Tag 037H.

proof.text: The standard Module.Finite.base_change instance proves finiteness over k'. Mathlib Module.finrank_baseChange identifies the dimension of k' ⊗_k L over k' with the dimension of L over k. Combine these with fieldness and pure inseparability to obtain all four clauses.
